Franklin Assistant

Ask Franklin anything.

Ask a normal question and get a direct answer in the conversation. Franklin Assistant uses Franklin Navigator data and current public sources behind the scenes when needed.

Simple by design
  • Direct answers in the chat
  • Follow-up questions stay in the same conversation
  • No account required
Ask a question

What do you want to know?

Franklin will answer here first. It will not send you through guides or other pages unless you specifically ask for a link, website or source.

Avoid passwords, account numbers and highly sensitive details. Questions may be processed by Franklin Assistant’s AI provider to generate an answer. For emergencies, call 911; for suicide or mental-health crisis support, call or text 988.

How it works

Your question stays in one chat. Franklin Assistant answers directly, keeps short follow-up context in the current browser tab, and uses verified Franklin or current public information when the answer depends on changing facts.

Privacy and safety

  • Questions and short current-tab chat context may be processed by Franklin Navigator’s Assistant service and OpenAI to generate a direct answer. Raw chat history is not saved to My Franklin by the Assistant.
  • Avoid passwords, account numbers and highly sensitive medical, legal or financial details. Attachments remain on your device in the current Assistant flow.
  • Franklin Assistant does not replace emergency services. If Franklin cannot verify a changing fact, it should say so instead of guessing.
